changes: 📝 New: Syndy's weekly recap — a real narrative posted to Group Chat, not a stat dump. Looks at the most recently saved week: who won, who's on a cold streak, who just broke a losing run, and who's still leading the season. Template-based with varied phrasing per beat (not a live LLM call, deliberately, for an unattended post), runs weekly.

🏉 New: pre-round hype posts — checks real AFL fixture data daily, and once a new round's kickoff is within 48 hours, posts a hype message using real data: kickoff day, game count, and who's currently leading the Tipping ladder. Won't repeat for the same round.
